notes.title: ARC Continuum Released!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that ARC Continuum is now full release. We have spent the last few months taking your feedback, improving systems and finishing the content for the game. The final release continues the story with it additional levels, puzzles and enemies variations. As we move forward we look forward to receiving your feedback to continually improve the game. 

We would like to thank everyone who participated in the Early Access program and helped us continue working on the game. We hope the continued interest will flourish and allow us to expand the ARC Continuum universe.

notes.title: ARC Continuum First Update
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has purchased ARC Continuum so far, we have got a lot of great feedback and are taking steps to improve the game going forward.

In our first major update we have added functionality to display help text in certain areas to improve the initial experience of learning the controls.

In addition we have added a new multiplayer map to play in. We are working on improving multiplayer functionality, but for now players will create sessions when they select multiplayer. If another player then selects multiplayer they will join that session. 

If you have suggestions for more updates feel free to let us know in the discussion page, we are here to get as much feedback as possible while we continue to update the game.

Thanks again to everyone, hope to hear from you soon ːsteamhappyː
